searchText: Creating a thread for this. I've done quite some simulation on this My writeup is here: https://ethresear.ch/t/wen-fast-payload-broadcast-segment-code-push-pull-and-everything-in-between/25913 Before I get critisized for the writeup quality, here I admit publicly that it was prepared in a hurry. We (me and many others) have been working on fast large message diffusion (for blocks as the main target, obviously) for a long time. I'm now on EL, so this was not my first priority, but not seeing it proposed for Hegota in a clear and focused form is I think a huge missed opportunity that we can and should correct, if there is agreement on it. So I did the new simulations and writeup with go-libp2p. My old simulations were using nim-libp2p as a sideproduct of DAS work (segment, erasure code, but don't sample), and showed good results too. Also if clients show interest I can promise a working PoC in just a couple of weeks
